homeTitle: Pikobuy Finds, Product Links & Buying Guides
homeDescription: Discover Pikobuy product links, browse shoes and clothing, and use independent guides to compare costs, check QC photos and plan shipping.
catalogDescription: Browse live product listings, compare indicative prices and open the original item details before ordering on Pikobuy. Use categories to narrow your search, then check the selected size, colour and total cost.
priceNote: Catalogue prices are indicative. Shipping and fees are additional; confirm the payable total on Pikobuy.
photoNotice: These are product listing images, not verified warehouse QC photos of your order.

shoes.title: Pikobuy Shoes: Product Links, Sizes & QC Checks
shoes.description: Browse shoe listings and compare the original product, selected size and visible details. A size label alone does not establish fit: check the seller’s chart and compare the measurement method with a pair you already wear.
checks: Confirm the selected size and colour on the original listing.
Use your own warehouse photographs to compare both shoes and their labels.
Compare packed dimensions with and without the retail box before choosing shipping.

hoodies-sweaters.title: Pikobuy Hoodies & Sweatshirts: Links and Sizing
hoodies-sweaters.description: Explore hoodie and sweatshirt listings, then compare chest width, body length and sleeve measurements for the exact variation. Check how the seller measures each dimension rather than assuming the same letter size fits across every listing.
checks: Compare flat garment measurements with a similar item you wear comfortably.
Check warehouse photographs for the selected colour, print, seams and cuffs.
Resolve size or condition questions before removing labels or submitting a parcel.

jersey.title: Pikobuy Jerseys: Product Links & Buying Checklist
jersey.description: Find jersey listings and check the selected style, size and printed details before paying. A catalogue image does not verify authenticity or show the condition of the unit purchased for you; compare the actual order with its warehouse evidence.
checks: Confirm the version, colour, size and any selected printed text.
Ask how body length and flat chest width are measured.
Check return eligibility before ordering a personalised or customised item.
